claim: quoteIdentifierIfNecessary(vars[0]) throws a TypeError when refIds is empty, because vars[0] is undefined and isValidIdentifier calls identifier.toUpperCase() unconditionally; initialQuery is computed in the render body so the render itself throws (previously the empty state harmlessly interpolated the string 'undefined'). On the alerting rule editor there is no local error boundary, so the throw reaches the page-level boundary and discards unsaved edits.
raw: #1 Critical: `quoteIdentifierIfNecessary(vars[0])` throws when `refIds` is empty, crashing the expression editor

claim: Both new tests call await resolveFunc() with no argument, but the plugin-ui contract declares resolve(TableIdentifier | null), so yarn typecheck fails with two TS2554 'Expected 1 arguments, but got 0' errors at lines 18 and 43 and the change cannot pass CI. The tests also exercise a call shape the production caller never uses.
raw: #2 High: the new completion-provider test does not type-check, so `yarn typecheck` fails

claim: The commit adds three quoting call sites but two different implementations: sqlCompletionProvider.ts:27 and SqlExpr.tsx:81 use the shared quoteIdentifierIfNecessary (which also rejects MySQL reserved words) while metaSqlExpr.ts:15 uses a private helper at line 114 checking only /^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*$/, so a query named a reserved word such as 'order' is quoted on two paths and left bare on the third.
raw: #3 Medium: the commit routes one of its three new quoting call sites through a weaker private duplicate of the helper

claim: quoteIdentifierIfNecessary wraps the value in backticks without doubling backticks already inside it, so a refId containing a backtick reshapes the generated SQL (e.g. 'A` , `B' yields two table references, 'A` UNION SELECT * FROM `B' yields a union, 'a`b' yields malformed SQL). The change makes three new call sites depend on it as a complete neutralizer.
raw: #4 Medium: the quoting helper this change now depends on does not escape embedded backticks

claim: The two new test files fail yarn lint (14 eslint errors: 6x @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any in sqlCompletionProvider.test.ts, plus 1x import/order and 7x no-explicit-any in metaSqlExpr.test.ts) and prettier --check (trailing whitespace in both). no-explicit-any is error repo-wide and these files are not in eslint-suppressions.json; the `as any` cast at line 11 also hides a refIds shape CompletionProviderGetterArgs would reject.

claim: The completion inserts a backtick-quoted table name into the Monaco buffer, but the mysql Monarch grammar emits the delimiter as its own identifier.quote token, so getTableToken returns the lone backtick and defaultTableNameParser yields { table: '`' }; fetchSQLFields then builds SELECT * FROM `` ` `` and the refId filter matches nothing, so column autocomplete stays silently empty for spaced names. Judged pre-existing because the unquoted path failed identically before the change.
